text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aah, Trainer!
Could it be that you're out shopping too, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the sweets section to do some shopping,
I ran into Winning Ticket and Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I came to buy some 'Insta-worthy'
sweets together with Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Sorry, I made
Ticket-san keep me company.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned there were some sweets I was curious about,
they invited me to go check it out together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, if Yuki-chan is curious about a sweet,
I'm curious about it too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're totally getting those Insta-worthy sweets!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we decided to shop together. However, the further in we went—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of a sweets battleground...!
There are so many people here...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The shop we're looking for is... oh dear,
it looks like it's way in the back. What should we do...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm, let me see—ah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide said it the other day! "If you think 'logi-cally,' nothing is impossible!" So let's think logi-cally!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Logically...? H-How do I even do that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well! Um, uhhh—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Hmmmmmm...????
choice_data_list: ...Maybe we could come up with a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!!!
Right, the STAGEGY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, what kind of strategy should we even use...!?
What do you think, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take another look at the crowd.
If there's any way out of this—
choice_data_list: Let's pick up the pace and overtake them one by one!
Let's read the flow of the crowd and make our way through.
Let's wait until the crowd thins out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it—!!
Let's pick up the pace and swooosh right through!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to weave through the crowd at a brisk
pace. However, making any progress proved
difficult amidst the throng of people—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I feel like I'm not moving forward
at all...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Yuki-chan, Trainer-san, over here!
Make a sharp turn around that corner!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I found the shop~~~!!
This is the right place, right!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes, that's definitely it!
I'll go buy it right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just now, Winning Ticket made her way through the crowd swiftly and with ease.
When asked how she did it—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe it's because
it's just like a race...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Like, in the middle of a race,
when I think, "Alright, time to speed up!"—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No matter how blocked the path ahead is, it fills me with the urge to push forward no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps Winning Ticket has some kind of secret
or knack for how she pushes forward."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! We managed to buy them!!
SWEETSSSS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ It's all thanks to Ticket-zo-san and Trainer cooperating with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you'd like, would you care to
eat together with everyone afterwards?
Please let me thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? ...*sob*,
Yukichan, you're so sweeeet~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it—!!
Let's read the flow of the crowd and swooosh right through!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kept walking, following the flow of the crowd as it
went straight and turned. Soon enough,
I began losing my sense of direction—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, which way was the shop again...?
Was it this way? Or that way...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You two, over here!!
Look, the shop sign—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right!!
I'll go buy some!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just now, Winning Ticket moved forward without losing her sense of direction at all.
When asked how she did it—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe it's because
it's just like a race...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: During a race, you just kinda sense the decisive momentand decide, 'Right here!' in your mind!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And then, magically, you stop hesitating and start moving forward by leaps and bounds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps Winning Ticket has some kind of secret
or knack for unleashing power when it counts."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! We managed to buy them!!
SWEETSSSS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ It's all thanks to Ticket-zo-san and Trainer cooperating with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you'd like, would you care to
eat together with everyone afterwards?
Please let me thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? ...*sob*,
Yukichan, you're so sweeeet~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! If we just wait, eventually
we'll be able to dash off at full speed, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it, what Yuki-chan is interested in are 'Insta-worthy' sweets, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still, I wonder what "aesthetic" actually means?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Jordan says it all the time, so I got kind of curious...
'Bae'? 'Fly'...? Hmmm???

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not super familiar with it either, but...
it seems like people use it to mean something looks great on social media!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Visual appeal!? Ah, so that's what 'bae' means!
I get it now~~!! You sure know a lot, Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we chatted, the crowd began to thin out little by little—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, it seems to be clearing up!
I bet we could buy some right now!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I'll go buy some!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! We managed to buy them!!
SWEETSSSS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ It's all thanks to Ticket-zo-san and Trainer cooperating with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you'd like, would you care to
eat together with everyone afterwards?
Please let me thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? ...*sob*,
Yukichan, you're so sweeeet~~!!"
